narrative.summary: No proxy and no owner. Its only ward is the DaiJoin adapter, whose vat() is the Sky Vat, which the Sky governance pause proxy controls behind a 2-day delay.
narrative.detail: Added 2026-10-11. Scored with the Sky pause target's own values (75 / 100 / 70, composite 81), re-read on every pass together with the ward set (replayed from the token's legacy LogNote history), the DaiJoin link to the Vat and the pause proxy's ward on the Vat. If any of those differs, the score degrades. Shares its root with the Sky pause, SparkLend and USDS, so its cross-exposure is lowered.
